tools.name: find_my_sign
tools.description: Returns the Chinese zodiac animal, element, polarity and zodiac year for a birthday, with the Chinese New Year boundary that decided it, or for a birth year alone.

tools.name: get_sign
tools.description: Returns a Chinese zodiac sign's years, personality, best and hardest matches, lucky numbers, colours and flowers, and its 2026 and 2027 outlook.

tools.name: get_birth_year
tools.description: Returns the animal, element and exact dates of a zodiac year from 1924 to 2032, with its personality, best and hardest matches, lucky things and 2026 and 2027 outlook.

tools.name: check_compatibility
tools.description: Returns how two Chinese zodiac animals sit together: the match level, why, and the traditional branch and element relations behind it. The same animal may be given twice.

tools.name: get_element
tools.description: Returns the Chinese zodiac element of a birth date or of a zodiac year, with what it means for that year's animal. Accepts a birth date or a year, not both.

tools.name: get_daily_reading
tools.description: Returns a sign's reading for a date, worked out from the day's animal and the traditional relations: work, love, energy, the best and hardest signs that day and the next seven days. The date defaults to today in China time (UTC+8).
